(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Secuura/Blockchain s164 (`%22`, 2026-09-10 06:10 → 07:21 AEST — the morning standing-queue seat) | **QUEUE CLEARED PLUS AN UNCOMMISSIONED REPO-WIDE UNBLOCK. Five PRs: #934 (KS-1067) · #935 (KS-1057) · #936 (KS-1058) · #937 (KS-1059) · F1/F2 on `039da8d6e`.** 🔴 **IT FOUND THE MORNING'S BIGGEST FACT UNASKED: `develop` is merge-frozen** — 55 of 56 develop-based PRs `blocked`, ZERO clean, all 15 approved-at-head among them — **with a same-sweep `dirty`/`clean` discrimination control, a dated prior reading (2026-08-27: zero blocked across 24) that makes it a CHANGE, and CODEOWNERS refuted with a positive control. And it REFUSED to assert the mechanism it could not read** (`/branches/develop/protection` 403s its PAT). That sentence is why Wednesday could ratify half the mail and route the other half to Kam. 🔴 **A SECOND repo-wide blocker measured and cleared in ~10 minutes:** a HIGH advisory refusing EVERY author's push, proven pre-existing on develop with a 211-entry control, fixed with **the baselined count UNCHANGED at 36 across both runs** — so the pass came from the advisory going, not the baseline growing. ✅ **IT REFUSED ITS OWN TICKET'S PRESCRIBED FIX SHAPE, on two independent legs**, proving that carrying `confidence` forward would make the verify endpoint report `pending-onchain` for a terminally failed anchor — the unearned claim #935 had just removed, one field over. **A ticket's prescribed REMEDY is a claim with a date on it, and only the seat holding the adjacent consumer could see it.** ✅ **AND IT DECLINED A GREEN IT COULD HAVE BANKED** — *"KS-1067's own push did NOT run the preflight ... it passed because the gate did not apply"* — then made the reverse inference on #937 and **accepted the correction as the error it would most want a successor to inherit.** ✅ **KS-1059's real content is far worse than its ticket:** that `inFlight &&` is the only thing stopping a terminally-failed document being rewritten to `status:'anchored'` **by a READ**.
